name: Suzumaru Souta
source:
A wolf boy with a cute face
Younger x Likable x Surprisingly masculine

Member of HEARTiS. Used to work in the same place as Airi. Though he's the youngest of the group, he's the most promising. He's hard not to like and has a cheerful air about him. He's also well known for being the cute guy that's willing to take part in variety shows with severe punishments. If he likes a girl, he'll show her his masculine side.

Hobby: playing the guitar, sleeping in
Likes: manga, anime, games
Hates: wasabi

[Translated from [url=http://www.entremets-cd.com/products/stalove]official website[/url]]
